summary: Multi-position tiled acquisition. Required for the Tiling widget.

fields.label: XY Positioner
fields.tip: Stage that moves between tile centres (must match a positioner in the setup).

fields.label: Z Positioner (opt.)
fields.tip: Reserved for compatibility and site extensions: the built-in Tiling controller does not use it. It is only checked to name a defined positioner.

fields.label: Align on (opt.)
fields.tip: Detector used for tile alignment. Empty = first forAcquisition detector.

fields.label: Detector transforms
fields.tip: Optional. How each additionally saved detector's pixels relate to the aligned-on one, e.g. {"APD1": "identity"} after confirming pixel registration. Detectors left out are still saved, recorded as 'unknown'.

fields.label: Default tile step (µm)
fields.tip: Default stage step between tile centres, in micrometres.

fields.label: Default tiles X
fields.tip: Default grid width. Equal to Y opens the widget with its square lock on.

fields.label: Default tiles Y
fields.tip: Default grid height.

fields.label: Default pattern
fields.tip: spiral = grows outward from the current position, stoppable early with a centred mosaic. serpentine = rasters from the current position in +X/+Y, no move longer than one tile step.

fields.label: Mode
fields.tip: Default acquisition timing model. free-running grabs a frame from a continuously running camera; triggered runs one scan per tile (scanned detectors, or a camera wired to the scan's trigger output).

fields.label: Scan source (triggered)
fields.tip: Widget key of the scan controller to trigger in triggered mode. Empty resolves automatically, which is unambiguous unless the setup has several scan controllers.

fields.label: Scan timeout (s)
fields.tip: How long to wait for one tile's scan to finish before giving up, in seconds.

fields.label: Settle time (ms)
fields.tip: Time to wait after each stage move before acquiring a tile, in milliseconds. Too short and tiles are captured while the stage is still ringing, which shows up as a mosaic that will not overlap cleanly. The widget can override it per run.

fields.label: Save tiles
fields.tip: Save every tile, plus the stitched mosaic and stitching sidecars (TileConfiguration.txt and tiles.json), as each run proceeds.

fields.label: Save format
fields.tip: Format for saved tiles. OME-TIFF is the default because it is what stitching tools read natively.

fields.label: Measurements folder
fields.tip: Base folder for saved tiling datasets. Empty uses the Recording widget's output folder, or the ImSwitch default measurements root when there is none. Each run gets its own <date>/tiling_<time> folder.

fields.label: Flip mosaic X
fields.tip: Mirror the mosaic along X when assembling it. Set it when the mosaic builds left/right opposite to the physical movement: the stitcher assumes a positive stage X move places the next tile further right. Affects only how tiles are assembled and how a click maps back to a stage position.

fields.label: Flip mosaic Y
fields.tip: Mirror the mosaic along Y when assembling it. See Flip mosaic X.

fields.label: Swap mosaic X/Y
fields.tip: Exchange the mosaic's X and Y axes, for a camera mounted at 90 degrees to the stage axes. Applied before the flips.

fields.label: Register tiles
fields.tip: Refine each tile's placement by phase correlation against its already-placed neighbours, instead of trusting the commanded stage position alone. Useful when the stage is not repeatable enough for seamless stitching.

fields.label: Max registration shift
fields.tip: Reject registration corrections larger than this fraction of the tile step. Guards against false matches on periodic sample structure.
